WASHINGTON/NEW YORK -- U.S. President Donald Trump rolled out the red carpet for Chinese leader Xi Jinping with a rare airport welcome, military honors and a lavish state dinner. But their three-day summit appeared to deliver only modest gains beyond a short-term trade truce extension, limited tariff relief and a fledgling dialogue on artificial intelligence.
